# MFLW (IEC 61850-7-4:2007B6), profile default

coverage: 10 measured or mapped, 9 mapped, 1 excluded, 0 unmapped, 26 not measured

## Measurements

MFLW.VlmCnt | volume | unit m³ | mflw.vlmcnt
MFLW.FlwRte | flow-rate | unit m³/s | mflw.flwrte
MFLW.FanSpd | rotational-speed | mflw.fanspd
MFLW.FlwHorDir | direction | unit deg | mflw.flwhordir
MFLW.FlwVerDir | direction | unit deg | mflw.flwverdir
MFLW.MatDen | density | unit kg/m³ | mflw.matden
MFLW.MatCndct | conductivity | unit S/m | mflw.matcndct
MFLW.MatLev | level | unit m | mflw.matlev
MFLW.FlwVlvPct | valve-position | unit % | mflw.flwvlvpct

## Data objects

VlmCnt BCR (MFLW): mapped mflw.vlmcnt
FlwRte MV (MFLW): mapped mflw.flwrte
FanSpd MV (MFLW): mapped mflw.fanspd
FlwHorDir MV (MFLW): mapped mflw.flwhordir
FlwVerDir MV (MFLW): mapped mflw.flwverdir
MatDen MV (MFLW): mapped mflw.matden
MatCndct MV (MFLW): mapped mflw.matcndct
MatLev MV (MFLW): mapped mflw.matlev
FlwVlvPct MV (MFLW): mapped mflw.flwvlvpct
Flw MV (MFLW): excluded — flow whose relation to FlwRte (volume flow rate) the model does not state
